lossless_replay.note: Repeated synthetic opaque fixtures. Untimed instruction counts differ in one scenario; no identical serialized stream is claimed. Raw counts are retained. No attribution of the difference without per-replay codec counters.

summary_method: Arithmetic means of two per-run summaries, not pooled percentiles or an overall desktop speed score. Initial80/10 B/A/A/B, separate diagnostic25/5 B/A/A/B, final120/10 A/B/A/B, same-image120/10 A/B/A/B. Each experiment uses an identical harness on both images.
limitations: Synthetic unpaced planner/FIFO/codec/protocol work to a discard socket; no capture, RDP transport, browser, Wi-Fi or physical input. Classification timings are overlapping worker wall sums, not additive frame latency or standalone CPU. Keep positive initial tails and negative-control variability alongside later improvements; do not claim a universal latency gain.
compression_policy: Existing PNG/WebP/JPEG, quality, lossless, geometry, worker admission and frame-order policies unchanged. PNG compression alternatives were not promoted; see separate complete study.

exploratory_harness_provenance.note: The early classification and nine PNG screening experiments used this frozen exploratory snapshot before mixed Cairo fallback observations were added. Neither native classification benchmark links PNG study controls. Exact raw harness hashes are retained; final confirmations use the committed harness. Early wrapper hash was not recorded.

record.measurement: production display planner, copy search, FIFO, workers, codecs and serialization to a shared discard socket
record.limitations: synthetic fixtures; no capture, RDP transport, browser, Wi-Fi, physical input or frame pacing; copied pixels/planner/encoding included, fixture generation excluded
record.fixture_note: original nine scenarios preserved; added all-solid, zero-copy-hit, early/late exact-copy-hit and alternating-size planner-reuse fixtures
record.policy_note: baseline never calls the setter and preserves its shipped policy (including private.6 default12); adaptive passes setter value1, enabling the candidate default12 rather than limiting it to one worker; only values greater than1 override the adaptive cap; fixed passes0 as a separate full-pool diagnostic; test_active_cap is the legacy setter-control value, not necessarily an observed worker count
record.verification: separate untimed strict ASCII protocol replay with real PNG/lossless WebP decoding and exact RGB comparison of every fixture pixel after each checked frame; timing/RSS captured before verification; opaque fixed-size fixtures only, not a general browser or alpha/resize validator

png_compression_study.scope: benchmark-only png_write_png interposition for indexed images; production defaults and Cairo fallback unchanged
png_compression_study.overhead: enabled builds add header-prefix coverage, thread-local and relaxed numeric counter work per image; compare off/default to measure overhead; no PNG control helper linked when off

record.statistics_note: planner counter deltas cover measured frames only; scratch bytes are retained-capacity gauges; unavailable baseline counters are null, not zero
record.planning_phase_timing_note: existing numeric TRACE phase durations captured without formatting; per-frame mean/p95 use integer-millisecond wall times; search includes both candidate indexing and copy search; zero phase durations are valid; phase quantiles cannot be subtracted from full-frame quantiles

encoder_control.method: benchmark-only ELF symbol interposition: auto forwards the original selector, fixed mode replaces only its decision, encoders always forward to the image's real implementations; hook coverage verified for every image; forced-lossless correctness replay disables overrides

encoded_fingerprints.method: per-image FNV-1a64 over concatenated encoded bytes before base64, aggregated as unsigned sum and XOR per codec independent of completion order; non-cryptographic integrity evidence alongside pixel replay, not a security proof
encoded_fingerprints.timing_note: enabled runs add per-byte hashing and must be excluded from headline performance comparisons; no encoded payloads retained or printed

record.encoder_timing_note: summed per-image encoder wrapper wall times include codec work plus streaming/serialization/socket waits; concurrent sums are not frame latency or standalone codec CPU; instrumentation is identical on old/new libraries

render_diagnostics.note: optional numeric telemetry adds clocks only in supporting libraries; use separate diagnostic runs when an older baseline cannot collect it; microsecond cumulative measured-frame deltas, maxima include initialization/warmup; overlapping phase sums and quantiles are not additive; no network-delivery timing
